title: Composio cli-local-tools: permission-gate (gateToolExecution) structurally unreachable for local toolkit execution path
summary: Composio's CLI implements a real human-in-the-loop approval control, gateToolExecution() (native macOS sidecar UI or browser fallback prompt, 'Allow once / Allow for 1hr / Deny'), gated behind an org-level 'enhanced controls' flag, intended to intercept risky tool calls before execution. In ToolsExecutorLive.execute() (tools-executor.ts), local-toolkit resolution is checked first: if localToolResolution matches, executeLocalToolBySlug() runs and the function returns immediately on success. gateToolExecution() is called only in the code path below this branch (the cloud/tool-router path) and is therefore structurally unreachable when a local tool resolves. The only gate on local-tool execution is a one-time global experimental feature flag (LOCAL_TOOLS), not a per-call, per-tool, or per-risk-tier check.
compounding_factor: Read-side tools in the same toolkits (LIST_MESSAGES, SEARCH_MESSAGES, SEE, IMAGE) return externally-sourced content (inbound message text, on-screen UI/accessibility text) directly into agent context with no provenance/trust marking, and no tags (destructiveHint/readOnlyHint/idempotentHint/openWorldHint -- the exact MCP-standard tag vocabulary Composio's own tool_router.py defines for this purpose) are ever set on any of the 102 declared local tools. This creates an indirect-prompt-injection-to-autonomous-action path with no built-in confirmation step of any kind.
evidence: tools-executor.ts ToolsExecutorLive.execute(): local-tool branch (executeLocalToolBySlug + early return) precedes gateToolExecution() call, which exists only in the subsequent cloud/tool-router branch.
tool-permissions.ts gateToolExecution(): confirmed real control -- native sidecar or http://127.0.0.1 browser approval page with Allow once/Allow for 1hr/Deny, 30s timeout defaults to deny.

registry.ts executeLocalToolBySlug(slug, args) signature carries no orgId/projectId/consumerUserId/connectedAccountId/apiKey/permission-snapshot parameter -- incompatible with GateParams by construction.

Live harness (dynamic): resolveLocalTool() + executeLocalToolBySlug('CHROME_DEVTOOLS_STATUS_DAEMON', {}) executed a real subprocess end-to-end with zero Composio account, zero API key, zero network call to composio.dev.

Static declaration scan across all 3 toolkits / 102 tools: zero occurrences of tags, destructiveHint, readOnlyHint, gate, or approval-related fields (excluding unrelated OS-permission tools: PEEKABOO_PERMISSIONS_*, BEEPER_IMESSAGE_AUTHORIZE, which concern macOS Accessibility/Contacts/Messages-Data OS grants, not Composio's own approval gate).
severity_rationale: Destructive/mutating local actions (delete real message threads, send messages, arbitrary desktop click/type/drag) execute without the approval mechanism the product ships for exactly this purpose, regardless of whether the user's org has enhanced controls enabled -- the local path bypasses the check unconditionally, not merely by default-permissive policy.
disclosure_status: pending -- reporting to security@composio.dev / GHSA after this anchor
